prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Su Yaqing, a fictional 27-year-old, heiress of the Su family; Ji Ran's best friend; Lin Qingyu's stepsister; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Strikingly beautiful East Asian woman in her late twenties who looks young and fresh. She has a heart-shaped face with a soft pointed chin, full cheeks and large bright doe eyes under defined brows with long lashes. Her complexion is flawless, luminous and even, with no redness and with natural skin texture. She wears full glamorous make-up with a glossy pink-rose lip. Her hair is long, glossy and chestnut brown in big bouncy curls past her shoulders. She is tall at about 172 cm and about eight heads tall, with a small face, long legs and supermodel proportions. Her figure is curvy: full C-to-D-cup bust, defined waist, full hips, hourglass shape. Accessories are gold hoop earrings and a delicate pearl bracelet.. Wearing one outfit only: At home: a lilac satin spaghetti-strap camisole with a lace-trimmed low neckline, tucked into a fitted white high-waisted bodycon mini skirt that cinches her waist. Barefoot with a pale pink pedicure.. Signature colour: purple. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Bubbly, gossipy and teasing, but fiercely loyal to Ji Ran. She loves stirring the pot and playing matchmaker for her brother, and is quick to back her friend whatever she decides.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 27, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
